name: lib_pisano_pos_and_period
statement: (m N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hper : ∀ i : ℕ, Nat.fib (i + N) ≡ Nat.fib i [MOD m]) : 0 < p3_pisano m ∧ ∀ i : ℕ, Nat.fib (i + p3_pisano m) ≡ Nat.fib i [MOD m]
closed: ∀ (m N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hper : ∀ i : ℕ, Nat.fib (i + N) ≡ Nat.fib i [MOD m]), 0 < p3_pisano m ∧ ∀ i : ℕ, Nat.fib (i + p3_pisano m) ≡ Nat.fib i [MOD m]
informal: Specification of the Pisano period p3_pisano (an sInf): as soon as Fibonacci mod m has some positive period N, p3_pisano m is positive and is itself a period. Promoted from Mathlib2.bld2_pisano_fib_odd_eq_aux1.
type: ∀ (m N : ℕ), 0 < N → (∀ (i : ℕ), Nat.fib (i + N) ≡ Nat.fib i [MOD m]) → 0 < Mathlib2.p3_pisano m ∧ ∀ (i : ℕ), Nat.fib (i + Mathlib2.p3_pisano m) ≡ Nat.fib i [MOD m]
